subject: info-f-d
title: INFO.F.D.------ALT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 237 (WAC-35). INFO-F-D (information focus distortion) is the subject; ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT (social reality). From ALT-F: PRI-INFO (principle information). From SOC-RT: ALT-F, STF (source transfer), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality). SPTC-D (spectacle diversion) is on a dotted line from STF. From INDIV-DY-RT: SPT-AW (spiritual awareness). IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is on a dotted line from INDIV-DY-RT.
